segments.ja210:1.1: Ambho ko nāma yaṃ rukkho, sinnapatto [sīnapatto (sī. pī.)] sakaṇṭako;
segments.ja210:1.3: Yattha ekappahārena, uttamaṅgaṃ vibhijjitaṃ [visāṭikaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), vighāṭitaṃ (sī. niyya)].
segments.ja210:2.1: Acāri vatāyaṃ vitudaṃ vanāni, kaṭṭhaṅgarukkhesu asārakesu;
segments.ja210:2.3: Athāsadā khadiraṃ jātasāraṃ [jātisāraṃ (ka.)], yatthabbhidā garuḷo uttamaṅganti.
segments.ja210:5.1: Daḷhabandhana haṃsavaro ca puna, virūpakkha saviṭṭhaka macchavaro;
segments.ja210:5.3: Sakuruṅga saassaka ambavaro, puna kukkuṭako garuḷena dasāti.

lines: Tattha ambho ko nāmayaṃ rukkhoti, bho khadiravaniya, ko nāma ayaṃ rukkho.
Uttamaṅgaṃ vibhijjitanti sīsaṃ bhinnaṃ, na kevalañca sīsaṃ, tuṇḍampi bhinnaṃ.
So vedanāppattatāya khadirarukkhaṃ “kiṃ rukkho nāmeso”ti jānituṃ asakkonto vedanāppatto hutvā imāya gāthāya vippalapi.
Taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā khadiravaniyo dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Athāsadā khadiraṃ jātasāraṃ, yatthabbhidā garuḷo uttamaṅgan”ti.
Athāsadā khadiraṃ jātasāranti atha potakakālato paṭṭhāya jātasāraṃ khadiraṃ sampāpuṇi.
Yatthabbhidā garuḷo uttamaṅganti yatthabbhidāti yasmiṃ khadire abhindi padālayi.
